D: Diffusion constant of the molecule in its medium
P: Piston pressure at which the flow through the membrane turns around
Pi: Osmotic pressure: the pressure on the solution that just stops water crossing into it
V_s: Volume of the hemoglobin and other solids in the cell, which takes no part in osmosis
c: Concentration of the solute, moles per cubic meter (1 mmol/L = 1 mol/m³); for the red cell, the outside osmolarity
c': Concentration of the sugar after the water that crossed has diluted it
c_out: Osmolarity of the salt water outside the cell
i: Number of particles each unit of solute makes in water: 1 for sugar, 2 for salt
k: Constant of the cell: its water volume times the outside osmolarity
t: Time since the molecules left the line
x_rms: Root mean square distance of the molecules from the starting line, along one direction
